items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: who was your music teacher when you had one? Well, after I started playing, Professor Chalini. He used to have music classes, 25 cents a lesson. Every Sunday I used to go.

ctx.x: How old were you then? Well, I guess I was about 10 or 11. And you said you started playing on your own? Yeah. But you did have music lessons later?

Yeah, well, I used to take old-time Victrola and play different records by Lewis and listen at them. And that's the idea of trying to play a trumpet. Well, who was your music teacher when you had one? Well, after I started playing, Professor Chalini. He used to have music classes, 25 cents a lesson. Every Sunday I used to go. I could play, but I couldn't read. So I decided to take up music in order to read.
Well, after you got out of school was when you started to play and earn it for professional purposes. Oh, yeah. Well, did you have your own band or did you play with someone else?
